notes: Every number is a measurement on the Arc A770 (llama.cpp Vulkan, -ub 512); the ledger config/models.md holds the rows. capability values are the model card's or the quantiser's own evaluation, named in capability_source. builder.env and the environment override any A770B_<NAME>_* value; the card reports what is served. useful_ctx is the largest depth at which decode stays above four tokens a second, taken from the 8k and far-end points by extending the time per token linearly, capped by the depth probe where one failed. Its rows were measured under the client's default temperature (0), before the profiles carried a sampling line. Rows are compared on their task numbers only within one instrument; the card's comparable_with lists them.

long.architecture: dense, hybrid attention (Gated DeltaNet + gated attention, 4 KV heads)
long.measured_on: Arc A770 16 GB, llama.cpp b10805 Vulkan

fit.code: T1: 11 tests green in 121 s, the repository's test idiom followed unprompted (measured at the client's temperature 0)

long.use_for: The default: every ordinary change, tests from a specification, and a read up to about 64k. Reads exactly at 100k but takes eleven minutes to get there.

fast.architecture: dense, sliding window 512 on five of six layers
fast.task_t1: weak: one of three edits made on a shell brief, three reported
fast.measured_on: Arc A770 16 GB, llama.cpp b10805 Vulkan

fit.code: T1: green twice and partial once (17, 6, 6 tests) at 74 to 82 s; on the harness's own brief one edit of three made, three reported (measured at temperature 0)

fast.use_for: The fast reader: a large file read cold in about four and a half minutes at 100k and precise questions about a passage deep in it. Not the profile for edits.

serious.architecture: dense, hybrid attention (4 KV heads, 64 blocks)

thinking.source: huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B model card's thinking line; reasoning effort low ruled by this project for speed (formerly carried through --chat-template-kwargs, now the first-class --reasoning-effort flag)

serious.measured_on: Arc A770 16 GB, llama.cpp b10805 Vulkan
serious.capability_source: ISTA-DASLab GSQ-RCO model card (quantiser's evaluation; BF16 85.71 / 89.90 / 100)

sampling.source: huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, thinking mode; reasoning effort low

fit.code: T1: 5 tests green in 1,492 s (measured at temperature 0); the same file at 196,608 under its card line: 10 in 546 s

serious.use_for: A deliverable larger than its brief, tests written from an unfamiliar module, a change touching several files. Ten to twenty-five minutes; decode under five tokens a second by 64k, so point it at files that fit 32k. A measured card may run the IQ3_S file at a larger window through builder.env.
